name: kiosco-pro
description: Sistema de gestión para kiosco: Firebase (Auth + Firestore + Cloud Functions) y Netlify

scripts.emuladores: npm run compartido && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-kiosco
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:functions: npm run compartido && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-kiosco "node --test tests/functions/*.test.js"
